query:
Find the most recent published democracy classifications for Pakistan:
1. Freedom House 'Freedom in the World': status (Free / Partly Free / Not Free) and global score out of 100, from the freedomhouse.org country report page.
2. V-Dem 'Regimes of the World' classification (Liberal Democracy / Electoral Democracy / Electoral Autocracy / Closed Autocracy) from the latest V-Dem Democracy Report or v-dem.net; note if it is in the grey zone (upper/lower bound).
3. EIU Democracy Index category (Full democracy / Flawed democracy / Hybrid regime / Authoritarian) and score.
Report each index separately with its edition year, the exact URL that states the classification, and a short verbatim quote. Omit an index rather than guess if its classification cannot be found.

assessments.publication: V-Dem Democracy Report 2026 (Regimes of the World, 2025)

text: V-Dem’s table marks Pakistan EA without a + sign, so it is not in the upper-bound grey zone. The EIU’s publisher report confirms the 2.44 score, while the linked classification table is a secondary reproduction because a publisher-hosted Pakistan classification for the 2025 edition was not located.
